messages:
ranjit: Hi team — first day. I can SSH to bastion-uk-1, but https://docs.corp.redwood times out in my browser. I can ping 10.45.4.20 over wg0 though. Anyone seen this with UK home ISPs?
chelsea: welcome! :wave: did you install the onboarding WireGuard profile from the SSO portal or a manual config?
ranjit: used onboarding-uk.conf pushed via the portal. WireGuard client shows connected, AllowedIPs = 10.45.0.0/16, 10.45.1.10/32.
netops: that /32 for DNS is suspicious. Can you paste `cat /etc/resolv.conf` and `wg show` (redact your keys)?
ranjit: resolv.conf points to 127.0.0.53 and search corp.redwood. `wg show` lists endpoint 51.140.12.7:51820 and AllowedIPs as above.
chelsea: ok resolvectl should be authoritative. Try `resolvectl query docs.corp.redwood` and also `curl --resolve docs.corp.redwood:443:10.45.4.20 https://docs.corp.redwood/` to force the internal IP for HTTPS.
ranjit: `resolvectl query` returns 10.45.4.20. `curl --resolve ...` loads the docs OK, so the service is reachable via the tunnel. Browser is hitting the public IP for some reason.
netops: browsers often have DoH or their own DNS cache and may prefer public A records. Quick fixes: 1) clear browser DNS cache and disable DNS-over-HTTPS while troubleshooting. 2) add a per-domain resolver mapping: `sudo resolvectl dns wg0 10.45.1.10` and `sudo resolvectl domain wg0 ~corp.redwood`. 3) use an SSH SOCKS proxy through the bastion: `ssh -D1080 ranjit@bastion-uk-1` and set browser to SOCKS5 localhost:1080.
ranjit: cleared Chrome cache and turned off DoH, docs loads now. SSH SOCKS works too.
bastion-bot: user/ranjit provisioned on bastion-uk-1
ranjit: thanks! one follow-up: trying to mount NFS at 10.45.9.8:/exports/home, but mount hangs until I curl via bastion. Is NFS expected to work over split-tunnel?
chelsea: NFS can be flaky over split-tunnel because of ephemeral ports and RPC. Workarounds: 1) use SSHFS via bastion (`sshfs ranjit@bastion-uk-1:/exports/home ~/mnt`) for day-to-day. 2) enable full-tunnel while mounting if policy allows. 3) we also have an HTTPS-based file proxy service for large transfers.
it-support: opened ONB-621: "WireGuard profile DNS allowed-ips uses /32 causing resolver routing issues for some clients" assigned to @netops to update templates and onboarding docs.
ranjit: SSHFS worked straight away, huge relief. I'll paste my steps into the onboarding doc. Thanks for the quick help! :tada:
chelsea: welcome aboard! we'll add a short FAQ for UK WFH DNS/browser DoH issues in onboarding.
